title: Looking for artists for comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! author: Lai (@willai3213)
title: Exhibition designer needed including 6 character visuals
content: [Recruiting | Exhibition graphic design project collaboration] Preparing an exhibition at Huashan, Taipei in early December. Seeking a graphic designer for: main visual, wordmark, character visuals (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, banners, other exhibition collateral, and print proofing. Timeline: early Oct first drafts, mid Oct finals, early Nov all outputs, mid Nov to print, early Dec exhibition. Looking for exhibition/graphic design experience, hand-drawn Japanese warm style. Interested designers comment or DM with portfolio + quote. Contact: DM or comment @willai3213
